hermes_limitations: Carlos HC-Q8 publisher-current Hermes ran on Ciru; the original six and Orca ran on Sozo. Do not interpret its wall-time position as a controlled same-host performance ranking.
Halogen retained its 45,056-token native output ceiling because a full-context output allocation exceeded Sozo memory; output allowance was not identical across stacks.
Carlos pass 2 HA-07 reached the 1,800-second case boundary and scored zero. It has no final agent-result record or complete primary-tool count.
Official scores and verifier pass/partial/fail are distinct: for example, HA-17 may receive 70/100 while retaining a fail verdict. Mean task status is mixed when the two verdicts differ.
Hermes tool-internal summarizers retain task-specific sampling/output budgets. One v5 pass-1 delegated request inherited matching settings from server defaults; later stages made them explicit.
The replay is a visualization of recorded case durations, not a recording of concurrent agent execution or individually timed tool calls.
Orca is part of the approved Hermes/storage extension only; no absent panels are inferred.
global_caveats: Each panel measures a different aspect of a complete pinned deployment. There is no universal winner or combined score.
Use per-panel conditions: historical lifecycle differences, native timing definitions and host differences prevent an unqualified all-metric ranking.
Saved first outcomes and authorized existing repeated Hermes/Kairic experiments are preserved. Page creation performed zero model generations.
